title: Burial Depth — How Far Into the Answer Is the Answer?
tagline: The most-starred repo on GitHub yesterday was a set of rules telling coding agents to stop burying the answer. Rules are assertions. Paste a response and measure how many words of preamble, scaffolding and hedging sit in front of the first sentence that actually answers.
description: Measure how many words of preamble sit before an agent response actually answers, and check it against the published output conventions.
